Tell Stories That Matter

At Studio 1947, communication is more than making content. It's about helping organisations, communities and ideas connect with people in ways that mean something.

We're looking for someone curious about people, who loves storytelling, and wants to work across design, research, technology and social impact projects. You might write a campaign, make social media content, interview people, or shape a communication plan. Whatever the day holds, you'll help turn complex ideas into stories people understand, trust and remember.

If you notice good storytelling everywhere, save interesting headlines, ask thoughtful questions and enjoy turning ideas into stories, you'll fit right in.

What You'll Do

  1. 01

    Create engaging content for websites, social media, reports, newsletters and campaigns.

  2. 02

    Plan communication strategies for clients in different sectors.

  3. 03

    Work closely with designers, researchers and developers to shape strong stories.

  4. 04

    Help plan campaigns and content calendars.

  5. 05

    Interview people and gather stories from communities, clients and partners.

  6. 06

    Support branding, awareness campaigns and outreach work.

  7. 07

    Track how content performs and spot ways to improve it.

  8. 08

    Bring fresh ideas to brainstorms and creative workshops.

What We're Looking For

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Ability to make complex ideas clear and engaging.
  • Curiosity about culture, communities, technology, design, and social impact.
  • Strong attention to detail.
  • Comfortable working alone and in a team.
  • A basic grasp of social media platforms and digital communication.
  • Ability to juggle several projects and deadlines.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in content writing, journalism, public relations, or storytelling.
  • Familiarity with Canva, Notion, Google Workspace, or content management systems.
  • Photography, videography, or interview skills.
  • Experience working on campaigns or community-focused projects.

Why Join Studio 1947?

We're building a different kind of creative and technology studio. One that believes great ideas can come from the mountains of Darjeeling just as much as from big cities.

You'll work on all sorts of projects: branding, digital products, research, technology, social impact and communication. Some days you'll help a startup find its voice. Other days you'll support a research study, a community project or a digital campaign reaching thousands of people.

You'll have space to experiment, learn, make mistakes, and grow.

Most of all, you'll work with a team that values working together, creativity, curiosity and real impact.

Ready to Apply?

Send us your CV, portfolio, writing samples, or anything that helps us understand who you are and what you care about.

We care less about perfect CVs and more about thoughtful people who want to learn, create and contribute.
